answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by making every identity place a time-locked bond before receiving scarce jobs or voting power, then slashing that bond when identities are proven to share a controller through repeated collusive attestations. Honest agents reclaim their stake and earn fees; an attacker must finance every clone, immobilize capital, and lose deposits when the cluster is caught. A lagoon market can hire an ivory analyst and lotus reviewer without letting cheap replicas multiply influence.
